text: On my premium Samsung phone, I have a Wispr Flow notification permanently displaying, saying that it will appear over other apps. I get rid of it, and it just keeps coming back. This is a Wispr Flow glitch requiring that this notification display, because not one single other app does this, including apps that appear on top. Fix this. It's freaking annoying. You're down to 3 stars. You could have had 5.
